damage: 1.5x a pistol round (mul 1.2 vs 0.8, same weapon damage)
name: Hand Cannon
notes: One item for either hand, like the pistol. Main hand with a shield or other off hand, or dual wielded. The 6-round magazine is a placeholder pick.
pairing: Marker buffs hcannon_main / hcannon_off. With a pistol in the other hand (either way round): left click fires pistol, cannon, pistol, 100 ms apart, then the lone pistol's 300 ms before the next burst. Two cannons alternate muzzles every 600 ms.
primary: Alone: one heavy round every 600 ms (half the pistol's rate), 120% weapon damage.
secondary: Off hand: with a pistol or a cannon in the main hand, both at once (2 rounds, wide spread) at the cannon's rate; otherwise one round.
